## Setup:

This episode will describe the computational setup for this module. Briefly, we will connect to the University of Amsterdam compute cluster Crunchomics. 

## Introduction to unix shell:

This episode will cover the basics of working with a command line interface (or Unix shell). This episode prepares you for the RNA-seq and genome assembly tutorials later on. The materials are based on [Data Carpentries: Introduction to the Command Line for Genomics](https://datacarpentry.github.io/shell-genomics/01-introduction.html) and [Introduction to the CLI](https://ndombrowski.github.io/cli_workshop/source/bash_intro.html).

----- probably don't include R wrangling basics ------
## R wrangling:

This episode will cover some R basics (most likely already covered in first weeks of course by Emiel?)

- Based on carpentries + other tutorials
- Importing data into R
- Data frame manipulation using `dplyr`
- Making graphs using `ggplot2`
